My work has included building delivery functions, resource planning, risk governance and
        organizational design. It shapes the questions I bring to AI: what teams need to understand,
        how decisions are made, and who owns the outcome.

I write for architects, engineering and delivery leaders, product owners and PMO
        practitioners. This site connects the publications and living research behind that work.
